# ADR-3041: A04: Account lockout threshold setting for login family 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unlimited guesses defeat password controls.

## Decision

Identity services SHALL configure an account lockout threshold setting for login family 5 (A04-5).

## Consequences

Lockouts alert fraud systems.
